name: Cursify
tagline: The only cursor animation library you need
description: Ten-plus cursor replacements (fairydust trail, canvas particle trail, rainbow, springy, character-following) built as open-source React and Framer Motion components rather than one configurable cursor. A narrow, well-scoped sibling to the main UI Layouts registry.
